description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading firmware on Sony devices, including updating boot configuration partitions and performing eMMC upgrades with tar-archived images.

methods.name: update_bootconfig
methods.description: Updates the boot configuration partition with the specified index at a given offset, including handling of optional secondary partitions.

methods.name: sony_emmc_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function for Sony devices, handles partition preparation, flashing kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive, reformatting the data partition, and performing reboot.
